circleTeaser: Sawan Somwar tomorrow. A simple Shiva abhishek at home is enough.

dpb.confidenceNote: The Monday vrat for Shiva in Shravana is named directly in the Purana; specific fasting forms vary by region.

en.title: Sawan Somwar Vrat — the complete guide
en.heroSubtitle: The Monday fast of Shravana, done correctly and without fear.
en.deck: Why Mondays in Sawan belong to Shiva, what the scripture actually asks of you, and a vidhi you can complete at home in under an hour.
en.introHtml: Every Monday of the Shravana month is kept for Shiva. The vrat is simple at its core: a clean start, a sankalp, an abhishek, and a fast that suits your body. Everything else you have heard — that a broken fast angers the deity, that nirjala is mandatory, that an elaborate samagri list is required — is either regional custom or plain misconception. This guide separates the three.

blocks.title: Why this vrat
blocks.text: He who worships Shankara on the Mondays of Shravana with water and bilva alone attains the fruit of a great yajna.

sankalpa.gloss: For the grace of Shiva, I undertake this Shravana Monday vrat. Say it in any language you carry in your heart — no Sanskrit required.

samagri.name: Jal (clean water)
samagri.note: Ganga jal if you have it; plain water is fully valid

steps.title: Bathe and clean the puja space
steps.description: Morning bath, clean clothes. Wipe the altar and place the Shivling or Shiva image facing you.

steps.title: Take the sankalp
steps.description: Sit facing east. Take water in your right palm, speak the sankalp, and let the water fall.

steps.title: Abhishek with water
steps.description: Pour a steady, thin stream over the Shivling.

steps.title: Abhishek with milk, then water again
steps.description: Milk abhishek is loved across North India; scripture asks only for water and bilva.

dpb.prathaScope: Pan-India, strongest in UP, Bihar, MP

steps.title: Offer bilva leaves
steps.description: Place the trifoliate leaves smooth side down on the Shivling.

steps.title: Light the diya, offer dhoop and flowers
Japa — 108 names or the panchakshari
steps.description: Chant ॐ नमः शिवाय 108 times, or as many as your morning allows.

steps.title: Aarti and bhog
steps.description: Close with aarti. Offer fruit or mishri, then share it as prasad.

mantra.meaning: I bow to Shiva — the five-syllable mantra that needs no initiation.

blocks.title: Choose your fast

fasting.name: Nirjala
fasting.description: No food, no water, sunrise to sunset. Only for the able-bodied and experienced.

fasting.name: Sajal
fasting.description: Water, milk and fruit through the day. One sattvik meal after sunset puja.

fasting.name: Phalahar
fasting.description: Fruit, milk, sabudana and rock-salt preparations. Right for pregnancy, illness and age.

blocks.text: There is no nirjala mandate anywhere in the source text. The vrat is devotion, not endurance.

myths.question: I broke my fast by mistake. Is the vrat ruined and will something bad happen?
myths.answer: No. Complete the day with devotion and continue. No text attaches punishment to an honest lapse.

myths.question: Can women do abhishek during Sawan?
myths.answer: Yes. No Puranic source bars women from Shiva abhishek. Restrictions you may have heard are regional custom, not Dharma.

myths.question: Is the vrat invalid without a priest?
myths.answer: The Sawan Somwar vrat is a home observance. A purohit is a choice, never a requirement.

hi.title: सावन सोमवार व्रत — सम्पूर्ण विधि
hi.heroSubtitle: श्रावण के सोमवार का व्रत — शास्त्र के अनुसार, बिना भय के।
hi.deck: सावन के सोमवार शिव के क्यों हैं, शास्त्र वास्तव में क्या कहता है, और घर पर एक घंटे में पूरी होने वाली विधि।
hi.introHtml: श्रावण मास का प्रत्येक सोमवार शिव के लिए रखा जाता है। व्रत का मूल सरल है: स्नान, संकल्प, अभिषेक और अपनी क्षमता के अनुसार उपवास। बाकी सब — कि टूटा व्रत अनिष्ट लाता है, कि निर्जला अनिवार्य है — या तो प्रथा है या भ्रांति। यह मार्गदर्शिका तीनों को अलग करती है।
